text:
evan: Heads up — sample app using Redwood TS SDK blows up only on Workers: `TypeError: Redwood_default is not a function`. Node ESM works fine.

priya: How are you importing and what's your tsconfig?

evan: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'` then `const client = Redwood<{userId:number}>({ apiKey: RW_KEY })`. tsconfig: module=ESNext, esModuleInterop=false, no bundler resolution.

dorian: Classic dual-publish export + TS inference mismatch. Some edge bundlers resolve the `require` path or generate `exports.__esModule = true` wrappers.

tasha: On the types side, our SDK currently publishes overloads like:
```ts
export default function Redwood<T = unknown>(opts: Options<T>): Client<T>
export default function Redwood(opts: Options): Client
```
That can cause TS to choose the non-generic overload and drop generic info which then affects how code is emitted/polymorphed by bundlers.

evan: Interesting — in my editor the client type is `Client<any>` despite passing `<{userId:number}>`.

priya: Workarounds that usually unblock: 1) use named import if available: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference'` and call `createClient<{...}>(...)`; 2) enable `esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` in the app tsconfig; 3) set `moduleResolution: "bundler"`; 4) pin builder (esbuild) to >=0.17 in cloud/NPM.

dorian: SDK fixes we should push: - remove the ambiguous default overloads; expose a single generic factory (e.g., `export default function createClient<T = unknown>(opts: Options<T>): Client<T>`) and keep named alias. - publish explicit edge subpath in package.json exports (e.g., "./edge": "./dist/edge/index.mjs") and ship per-entry `.d.ts`. - add CI test matrix covering (ESM/CJS) x (esModuleInterop on/off) x (vite/esbuild/webpack) x (node/edge).

tasha: Also observed auth/retry wrapper weirdness: when imports get mangled wrappers can be layered differently and inner client loses forwarded credentials -> 401 -> retry loop. So any export shape change must validate middleware composition.

evan: Quick repro log from Workers deploy: `build-bot: upload failed: Error: TypeError: Redwood_default is not a function at worker.js:22`

priya: For immediate fix in the sample app: switch to `import { createClient as Redwood } from 'redwood-inference'`, set tsconfig to `{ "compilerOptions": { "esModuleInterop": true, "allowSyntheticDefaultImports": true, "moduleResolution": "bundler" } }`, and ensure tsup/esbuild is emitting the expected entry (`.mjs`) for edge. That got my deploy green.

dorian: I'll open an SDK issue with proposed changes + attach a tiny repro repo and the matrix plan. We should also add a note in docs for recommended tsconfig/bundler combos for edge.

tasha: Ping me if you want me to run esbuild versions against the repro in CI. Also we should validate that types inference works after moving to single-signature export (generics preserved).

evan: Thanks all — will push repro and link ticket. :raised_hands:
